method.record_universe: Every retained Wave 03 record. Five warning-to-decision candidates receive stage-level review; accident and recommendation-persistence controls receive control-level review.
method.chain_rule: provisional_ccd_chain_depth is the deepest uninterrupted documented stage beginning at stage 0; it is null when stage 0 is not documented.
method.furthest_rule: furthest_documented_stage records the most downstream documented stage without bridging an earlier causal gap.
method.disaster_rule: An accident or fatal consequence cannot substitute for a documented contradiction, reclassification, or explanation mutation.
method.distributed_system_rule: A system-scale disaster must be decomposed into bounded warning-to-decision transactions before event inclusion.
method.promotion_rule: No maintainer disposition creates an included K0 event, determines evidence truth, clears publication, assigns psychological motive, or creates a graph edge.

rows.matter: Challenger launch recommendation reversal, engineer exclusion, and post-testimony reassignment
rows.bounded_domain: Cold-temperature O-ring risk and STS-51L launch authorization
rows.qualification_basis: Morton Thiokol engineers responsible for the solid rocket motor field joint and O-ring assessment, including engineers who had inspected flown hardware and developed the relevant data.

source_packets.supports: Initial no-launch recommendation below 53°F, continuing engineer opposition, management reversal, burden reversal, launch authorization, and failure to communicate dissent to upper decisionmakers.
Direct testimony concerning the engineering-hat/management-hat instruction, exclusion of engineers from final decision charts, and management formulation of launch rationale.
Post-testimony reassignment of Allan McDonald and Roger Boisjoly away from solid rocket motor work and later restoration of McDonald after congressional and NASA pressure.

stage_assessments.basis: During the management caucus, the operative proposition became that launch could proceed because the engineers could not prove absolutely that the motor would fail.
Qualified solid-rocket-motor engineers recommended no launch below 53°F, presented physical evidence and prior-flight observations, and continued to oppose launch after management reversed course.

Engineering judgment was explicitly converted into a management judgment: the vice president of engineering was told to take off his engineering hat and put on his management hat, while dissenting engineers were not polled for the final rationale.

The readiness burden reversed from proving the system safe to requiring engineers to prove beyond doubt that it would fail; management then formulated a launch rationale unsupported by any engineer in the room.
Thiokol management reversed the contractor's no-launch recommendation and the launch authorization chain allowed STS-51L to proceed.
Challenger was destroyed and its seven crew members were killed.

Continuing engineering opposition disappeared from the organizational recommendation and was not communicated to upper launch decisionmakers; after testimony, two prominent dissenters were reassigned away from solid rocket motor work.

The prelaunch record shows no independent stay capable of preserving the engineering recommendation, but the complete internal appeal and refusal record is not public; post-disaster oversight later restored one dissenter and redesigned the system.

open_requirements: independent second-party adjudication of each transition and its temporal ordering
complete contractor personnel and appeal record for the dissenting engineers
bounded analysis of the prelaunch stay, escalation, and refusal mechanisms
separation of the launch-decision event from the later reassignment and restoration event

rows.matter: Columbia foam-strike imagery requests, burden reversal, and mission-management denial
rows.bounded_domain: On-orbit imagery and assessment of possible STS-107 thermal-protection-system damage
rows.qualification_basis: NASA and contractor engineers organized as the Debris Assessment Team, supported by thermal-protection and imaging specialists.

source_packets.supports: Three imagery requests, management routing and denial, burden reversal, communication failures, damage-assessment uncertainty, and organizational findings.
CAIB findings that imagery was treated as a noncritical engineering desire, engineers were required to prove unsafe, and communication was stifled.
Engineers requested high-resolution imagery for a more complete analysis and managers turned down the request before re-entry.

stage_assessments.basis: Program management treated the foam strike as lacking a demonstrated safety-of-flight consequence unless engineers could prove that the vehicle was unsafe.
The Debris Assessment Team documented substantial uncertainty and repeatedly requested on-orbit imagery to bound the damage analysis.
The comprehensive public record does not identify a bounded engineer whose competence, loyalty, standing, or motives were reclassified by the decisionmaker.
A critical operational evidence request was reframed as a noncritical engineering desire and then filtered through a demand for a mandatory requirement.
Mission and program management did not obtain the requested imagery and the three requests failed within the management hierarchy.
Columbia re-entered with an undetected wing breach and was destroyed with its seven-member crew.
The requested evidence channel was denied and communication was stifled, but the engineers themselves remained active and the record does not establish complete removal of a feedback source.
The record identifies weak safety authority and ineffective escalation, but does not establish every possible repair, rescue, stay, or appeal route as materially blocked.

rows.non_link_reason: The official record establishes burden reversal, evidence-access failure, and management denial, but not the bounded knower reclassification required for a ceiling-conversion event.
open_requirements: a source-bounded knower reclassification rather than reclassification of the request alone
the exact decision and communication record for each imagery request
an independent assessment of whether this should remain an evidence-gate failure outside K0
separate causal analysis of possible repair or rescue options without hindsight inflation

rows.matter: NDK Crystal pressure-vessel warnings, continued operation, and inspection failure
rows.institution: NDK Crystal / insurer and consultant / Illinois pressure-vessel oversight
rows.bounded_domain: Inspection, return to service, and continued operation of high-pressure crystal-growing vessels
rows.qualification_basis: The vessel designer, an insurer-retained engineering consultant, metallurgists, and pressure-vessel specialists.

source_packets.supports: Acmite-protection assumption, 2007 stress-corrosion event, consultant's serious reservations, catastrophic-risk warning, continued operation without certified body inspections, and fatal rupture.
Inspection recommendations were never performed and a specific warning was made by the company's insurer.

stage_assessments.basis: NDK relied on the acmite coating to protect the vessel interior and continued treating the vessels as fit for service.

After a 2007 stress-corrosion incident, an engineering consultant expressed serious reservations, called return to service seriously flawed, warned of catastrophic public risk, and the designer had recommended annual nondestructive inspections.
The official packet does not show that the designer, consultant, insurer, or warning was reclassified as incompetent, disloyal, captured, or otherwise inadmissible.
The packet does not document an explanation-before/explanation-after ratchet applied to the warning source.
NDK continued operating the remaining vessels without thorough certified inspection of the vessel bodies.
A vessel ruptured, killing a member of the public, injuring another, and causing extensive damage.
The warning was not followed, but the packet does not establish that the consultant, insurer, or another feedback source was removed from the institution.
The state approval and inspection regime failed to prevent continued operation, but the complete internal correction and appeal record is not supplied.

open_requirements: management and regulator records showing how the consultant's warning was classified
the exact explanation for continued operation after the insurer's warning
the decision roster and authority basis for inspection and return to service
independent review distinguishing ignored warning from ceiling-conversion reclassification

rows.matter: East River doors-off helicopter pilot warnings, complaint conversion, and exclusion from safety meetings
rows.bounded_domain: Harness, tether, control-entanglement, passenger-egress, and flotation risks in FlyNYON doors-off operations
rows.qualification_basis: Liberty pilots and safety personnel with direct operational knowledge of the aircraft, harness/tether system, passenger egress, and emergency procedures.

source_packets.supports: Pilot warnings, shutdown of concerns, exclusion from meetings, CEO control over safety-equipment decisions, deficient safety management, accident causes, and five deaths.
Probable cause, contributing safety-management and oversight failures, consequences, and safety recommendations.
Operational warning history and the significance of pilots' predicted harness, egress, control-entanglement, and flotation risks.

stage_assessments.basis: NYONair leadership treated pilot meetings as an inefficient open forum with too much complaining and talking.
Liberty pilots and safety personnel repeatedly raised operational concerns about harness/tether entanglement, passenger egress, flotation, and other FlyNYON risks.
The safety warnings were recoded as complaining; pilots were described as being shut down and were told they could no longer participate in the meetings.
Operational safety evidence became a meeting-efficiency and attitude problem rather than a risk requiring mitigation.
The CEO limited meeting participation, retained decisive influence over safety equipment and policies, and the doors-off operation continued without adequate mitigation.
A tether activated the fuel shutoff lever, the helicopter ditched and capsized, harnesses impeded egress, and five passengers drowned.
Pilots were excluded from the principal joint meeting surface, the mechanism for raising concerns was ineffective, and safety authority remained concentrated with management.
The report documents ineffective internal safety governance and inadequate oversight, but not the complete pre-accident appeal, stay, refusal, and retaliation record.

open_requirements: full meeting minutes, warning texts, and participant chronology
complete employment and retaliation records for the pilots who raised concerns
bounded analysis of every available pre-accident stop or escalation route
independent adjudication separating Liberty, NYONair, and FAA decision chains

rows.matter: Grenfell resident safety warnings, militant-troublemaker classification, and distributed institutional nonresponse
rows.institution: Kensington and Chelsea TMO / RBKC / building-safety system
rows.bounded_domain: Resident fire-safety complaints, landlord governance, and pre-fire correction authority at Grenfell Tower
rows.qualification_basis: Grenfell residents possessed situated knowledge of their building and landlord response; the London Fire Brigade and other professional bodies supplied additional technical warning channels.

source_packets.supports: TMO treatment of residents, militant-troublemaker classification, failure to take concerns seriously, resident fire-safety warnings, and the unequal dependence relationship.
Residents were belittled and marginalised, classified as militant troublemakers, and dependent on the TMO for a safe home.
Persistent failure to prioritize fire safety, failure to respond to residents and external concerns, and distributed institutional responsibility.

stage_assessments.basis: The TMO treated some residents and activists as militant troublemakers, nuisances, or sources of offensive and inconvenient complaints.
Residents raised specific fire-safety concerns, including the warning that only a catastrophic event would expose the TMO's failures; professional fire-safety concerns also reached the institution.
Residents' situated knowledge and complaints were recoded through a durable classification of vocal residents as militant troublemakers and activists rather than credible safety sensors.
Fire-safety complaints and demands were processed as irritating, inconvenient, antagonistic conduct instead of evidence requiring institutional learning.

The inquiry documents many failures to act, but the current record combines multiple complaints, actors, refurbishment decisions, maintenance failures, and regulatory gates rather than one bounded transaction.
The Grenfell Tower fire killed 72 people and devastated the resident community.
Resident evidence was marginalised and discounted, but residents were not wholly removed from every channel and the exact sensor-loss transaction must be decomposed.
Residents depended on the TMO and lacked binding pre-action authority, but the appeal, regulatory, tenancy, and remedial routes vary across the distributed chain.

decomposition_targets: resident fire-safety instruction and evacuation complaints
Grenfell Action Group warnings and TMO response
London Fire Brigade enforcement and TMO escalation
fire-risk-assessment remedial work and maintenance gates
refurbishment design, procurement, building-control, and product-certification decisions
open_requirements: one bounded warning-to-decision transaction per proposed subevent
exact gateholder, authority basis, date window, and consequence for each subevent
separation of resident situated knowledge from professional and regulatory warnings
independent review preventing the distributed disaster from being compressed into one actor-centered event

rows.matter: Cape Douglas sinking without documented K0 preconditions

source_packets.supports: Completed investigation of flooding, open watertight doors, total vessel loss, and no injuries.

control_findings: The official record establishes an accident and operational causes.
It does not document a qualified warning reaching the decision surface before the sinking.
It does not document knower reclassification, explanation mutation, or exclusionary gate action, so severity cannot manufacture K0 inclusion.

rows.matter: Repeated DOT-111 tank-car recommendations and recommendation persistence
rows.institution: NTSB / PHMSA / FRA / railroad and tank-car regulatory system

source_packets.supports: Repeated NTSB warnings about DOT-111 vulnerability, reiterated phase-out recommendations, and a 2024 derailment with hazardous-material releases.
Accident findings, recommendation set, and completed investigation status.

control_findings: The record preserves a long-lived warning and recommendation stream across accidents and regulators.
It does not isolate one delivered contradiction, one bounded decision surface, or one explanation mutation.
Recommendation persistence is necessary denominator evidence but cannot be collapsed into a single K0 event or shared motive.
